scenes.title: His game failed
scenes.say: His video game failed. The chat tool behind it didn't.

scenes.label: Stewart Butterfield's game Glitch shuts down
scenes.say: In twenty twelve, Stewart Butterfield shut down his online game, Glitch.

scenes.label: Salesforce's price to acquire Slack, announced in 2020
scenes.say: Its internal chat tool became Slack, sold to Salesforce for twenty seven point seven billion dollars.
